messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: cont-batch pool cb-east-1 error rate > 8% and 95th latency > 2.5s for 3m. Samples show KV cache evictions spiking. Auto-pager triggered.
Mira (oncall): I'm on it, taking pager. Starting investigation. Any visible deploys? @deploy-bot any recent rollouts to cb-east-1?
deploy-bot: Recent rollout: config-change/contbatch-params v2026.03.15 by Mei at 1777552800. No service restarts.
Mira (oncall): thanks. @Priya can you pull perf dashboards (per-route, per-model) and KV eviction rates?
Priya (obs): Pulling now. KV cache evictions jumped x15 around 1777552700. max_batch_tokens for the pool is 4096 (was 2048 yesterday). max_num_seqs is 128. There are a lot of long-seq requests from a customer integration test queue.
Mira (oncall): Hmm. So config bump to max_batch_tokens right before the spike. Need quick mitigation: reduce batch token cap and throttle oversized seqs. @Devon can you push a hotfix to override pool config to 1024?
Devon (eng-runtime): I can push a runtime override via config-service. Preparing patch. Will toggle to 1024 and set max_num_seqs to 64 as emergency. Applying in 30s to cb-east-1 pools only. Rolling change (no restart).
Mira (oncall): Good. Also enable aggressive eviction backpressure so clients get 429s rather than causing cache thrash. Can we flip that?
Devon (eng-runtime): Adding flag 'contbatch.backpressure.mode=reject' for cb-east-1. Patching now.
Mei (prod): Noted customer-facing risk. Jorge, can you check if Prod customers are seeing increased error rates? Any support tickets?
Jorge (customer-success): CS queue shows two reports from a partner about slow responses for embeddings endpoints starting ~10m ago. I've messaged them to say we're investigating.
Devon (eng-runtime): Patches applied: max_batch_tokens=1024, max_num_seqs=64, backpressure=reject. Confirming config-service reports success to all nodes.
Priya (obs): Dashboards: KV evictions drop sharply after 40s post-change. 95th latency falling back to baseline by ~90s. Error rate still elevated but trending down.
Mira (oncall): Good. Can someone describe root cause hypothesis so I can summarize for incident log?
Liam (eng-sre): Hypothesis: rolling increase in max_batch_tokens allowed oversized batches that increased per-batch KV working set. With high sequence counts and large prefix/token accumulation, cache eviction thrash occurred leading to thrashing page faults and timeouts. The config change reduced the worst-case working set, allowing caching to stabilize.
Mei (prod): Any permanent mitigation we should enact? Suggestion: add conservative hard caps per-tenant and automated gating when eviction rate > threshold. Also add a canary gate when increasing max_batch_tokens.
Devon (eng-runtime): Agreed. I'll open a follow-up PR: add rollout prechecks and an automated kill-switch that enforces backpressure if eviction_rate > 3% for >1m. Also add telemetry events for max_batch_tokens changes.
Mira (oncall): Customer impact: brief slowdowns and 5-10% of requests returned 429/timeout to a small set of partners. Jorge to patch CS messaging: "We observed transient performance degradation tied to batching config; mitigation applied; investigating root cause; we'll follow up with timeline and corrective actions."
Jorge (customer-success): Drafted and sent out now to impacted partners.
Mei (prod): Do we need to escalate to SRE Lead or Eng runtime manager?
Liam (eng-sre): Not yet, stable and recovering, but please schedule a postmortem within 48h and include config-change owner. I'll take on the on-call writeup.
Mira (oncall): I'll mark incident status: mitigated. Creating incident ticket IN-1777553344 with timeline and actions.
Devon (eng-runtime): One more note: we should audit historical max_batch_tokens changes — there was a trend of incremental increases. I'll add that to the postmortem.
Mira (oncall): Thanks everyone. If latency re-spikes or error rate climbs >2% above baseline, re-alert here and escalate.
Mei (prod): Thank you. Closing handoff to postmortem.
Mira (oncall): Closing the live thread.
